req.title: Mark task complete
req.statement: The system shall set completed=true when a PUT payload includes {"completed": true}.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the functionality of marking a task as complete via the PUT /tasks/{task_id} endpoint. It includes a positive test to ensure the task is marked complete when the correct payload is provided, a negative test to handle cases where the task ID does not exist, and a boundary test to check the behavior when the task ID is at the boundary of valid IDs.

tests.name: test_mark_task_complete_positive
preconditions: A task exists in the database with a known ID.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/{task_id} with payload {"completed": true}.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a task to ensure it exists
response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Test Task", "description": "Test Description", "completed": false})
assert response.status_code == 201
created_task = response.json()
task_id = created_task['id']

# Mark the task as complete
response = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"completed": true})
assert response.status_code == 200
updated_task = response.json()
assert updated_task['completed'] is True

tests.name: test_mark_task_complete_nonexistent_task
preconditions: No task exists with the given ID.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/{nonexistent_task_id} with payload {"completed": true}.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the task was not found.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

nonexistent_task_id = 99999  # Assuming this ID does not exist

response = client.put(f"/tasks/{nonexistent_task_id}", json={"completed": true})
assert response.status_code == 404
assert "Task with id" in response.json()['detail']

tests.name: test_mark_task_complete_boundary_task_id
preconditions: A task exists in the database with the lowest possible valid ID.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/{boundary_task_id} with payload {"completed": true}.
tests.executable:

from app.main import app
